[[Hargrave Military Academy|Hargrave]] ([[Chatham, Virginia]]) | college = [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|North Carolina State]] (2010–2013) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = 2013 | career_end = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = *Second team All-[[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] (2013) *[[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2010 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2010]]) | stat1label = | stat1value = | stat2label = | stat2value = | stat3label = | stat3value = | letter = | bbr = | HOF_player = | FIBA_HOF_player = }} '''Lorenzo Brown''' (born August 26, 1990) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played collegiately at [[North Carolina State University]] and is projected as a late first or early second round selection in the [[2013 NBA Draft]]. Brown, a 6'5" [[Guard (basketball)|guard]] from [[Roswell, Georgia]], played for [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|NC State]] from 2010 to 2013. He started all three seasons and led the Wolfpack to consecutive [[NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Championship|NCAA tournament]] appearances in [[2012 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2012]] and [[2013 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2013]]. As a junior, Brown averaged 12.4 [[Points per game|points]] and 4.3 [[rebounds per game]] and led the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC) in [[Assist (basketball)|assists]] with 7.2 per game.{{cite web| last = | first = | title =Lorenzo Brown ESPN profile | publisher = ESPN.com | date = | url =http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/player/_/id/45537/lorenzo-brown | accessdate = May 7, 2013}} At the close of the season, Brown was named second team All-ACC.{{cite web| last = | first = | title =Howell One of Four Pack Players To Earn All-ACC Accolades | publisher = GoPack.com | date =March 11, 2013 | url =http://www.gopack.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/031113aaj.html | accessdate = May 7, 2013}} After the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2012–13 season]], Brown decided to forego his final season of college eligibility and declared for the [[2013 NBA Draft]].{{cite web| last = | first = | title =North Carolina State's Lorenzo Brown declares for NBA draft | publisher = Sports Illustrated | date =March 27, 2013 | url =http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/college-basketball/news/20130327/lorenzo-brown-nc-state-nba-draft.ap/ | accessdate = May 7, 2013}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.gopack.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/lorenzo_brown_710840.html NC State profile] {{Persondata | NAME = Brown, Lorenzo | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = American basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = August 26, 1990 | PLACE OF BIRTH = [[Roswell, Georgia]] | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Brown, Lorenzo}} [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:1990 births]] [[Category:Basketball players from Georgia (U.S. state)]] [[Category:NC State Wolfpack men's basketball players]] [[Category:Parade High School All-Americans (boys' basketball)]] [[Category:People from Roswell, Georgia]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:African-American basketball players]]
